derivation:
by
  simpa only [DFunLike.ext_iff] using (ContinuousMap.cancel_right (f₁ := g₁.toContinuousMap) (f₂ := g₂.toContinuousMap) (g := f.toContinuousMap) hf)
explanation: Specialize the independent cancellation theorem for continuous maps to the underlying continuous maps. Extensionality identifies both bundled equalities with the corresponding pointwise equalities.
